sonnet.problem: Card 4 already asked how long the LORD's Name stays at the temple and revealed the answer 'Forever'. Card 5 then asks the true/false 'His eyes and His heart will be at the temple for all time'. That is the same point, about duration, from the next line of verse 3. It also re-uses an answer already shown on an earlier card.
sonnet.rule: Two lines that make the same point get one question. An answer shown on one card, right or wrong, isn't used again on a later card.
